name: PT Modernland Realty Tbk
summary: PT Modernland Realty Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, develops and sells real estate properties in Indonesia. The company engages in the township, residential, and industrial town development business; and sale of real estate and apartments, as well as property leasing services. It also operates a four-star hotel under the Novotel Gajah Mada and Swiss-Belinn Modern Cikande brand name; and a golf and country club under the Padang Golf Modern and Country Club name. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Jakarta Barat, Indonesia.
